mapper.select: SELECT customer.customer_code AS code, customer.customer_name AS name, customer.customer_id AS value, customer.dept_id AS scope_dept_id, customer.owner_id AS scope_owner_id FROM crm_customer customer WHERE customer.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND customer.deleted = 0

SELECT CONCAT('CONTACT-', contact.contact_id) AS code, CONCAT(customer.customer_code, ' / ', contact.contact_name) AS name, contact.contact_id AS value, customer.dept_id AS scope_dept_id, customer.owner_id AS scope_owner_id FROM crm_contact contact JOIN crm_customer customer ON customer.customer_id = contact.customer_id AND customer.tenant_id = contact.tenant_id AND customer.deleted = 0 WHERE contact.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND contact.deleted = 0 AND contact.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT opportunity.*, customer.dept_id AS scope_dept_id, customer.owner_id AS scope_owner_id FROM crm_opportunity opportunity JOIN crm_customer customer ON customer.customer_id = opportunity.customer_id AND customer.tenant_id = opportunity.tenant_id AND customer.deleted = 0 WHERE opportunity.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND opportunity.deleted = 0 AND opportunity.owner_id = #{operatorId} AND opportunity.status = 'OPEN' AND opportunity.stage NOT IN ('WON', 'LOST') AND opportunity.opportunity_id > #{afterId}
AND opportunity.opportunity_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')

SELECT employee.employee_no AS code, employee.name AS name, employee.user_id AS value FROM hr_employee employee INNER JOIN sys_user account ON account.user_id = employee.user_id AND account.tenant_id = employee.tenant_id WHERE employee.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND account.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND employee.deleted = 0 AND employee.employee_status NOT IN ('RESIGNED', 'TERMINATED') AND account.deleted = 0 AND account.status = '0' ORDER BY employee.id

SELECT dict_value AS code, dict_label AS name, dict_value AS value FROM sys_dict_data WHERE tenant_id IN (0, #{tenantId}) AND dict_type = 'crm_customer_level' AND status = '0' ORDER BY dict_sort, dict_code
SELECT customer_code FROM crm_customer WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND customer_code IN #{code}
